key_insight: A multimodal deep learning model with self-attention can combine triage text complaints and vital-sign tabular data to improve emergency prioritization.
clinical_relevance: This approach may support faster and more consistent emergency triage decisions, helping prioritize patients who need urgent attention.
method: Trained a multimodal deep learning architecture on textual presenting complaints plus numerical vital signs.
Used self-attention to capture local and global feature relationships across both data types.
Compared performance against a baseline model for triage prediction.
evidence_signal: The model was developed and validated on 11,102 emergency department triage records and improved accuracy, F1-score, and ROC AUC by 1.95%, 2.49%, and 1.41%, respectively.
watch_item: Performance gains were shown in a single-hospital dataset, so external validation is needed before wider implementation.
paper_title: Multimodal Attention-based Deep Learning for Emergency Triage with Electronic Health Records
